# toColor

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`ColorInput`](color-input.md) to the canonical [`Color`](color.md).

Palette tokens resolve *through* `ColorPalette`, which stays the single source of truth for token hex values - this function holds no colour table of its own. An out-of-grammar hex string yields black, matching [`Color.fromHex`](color.md#fromhex); palette typos cannot reach here from typed callers because they do not compile.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toColor(input: ColorInput): Color
```
